title: Pamela J NDE 5192
content: I went into labor and then had to have an emergency cesarean section. It went bad. I was drowning in the fluids of my own body and from the childbirth. I was a chain smoker and I couldn't breathe. Then I saw a bright white light - beautiful, peaceful - and I was being drawn into the light, but I was being held back for some reason, like it was not my time. I heard the nurse say, 'Show her baby to her; it could be for the last time.' I didn't want to 'come back' to life. Where I was it was so peaceful and I wanted to stay there, I was not afraid. Six years later, I had another child and that erased the fear of death for me. I had a daughter. I had no problem with the pregnancy. When I had the near death experience, I became a believer, but not a strong believer. My husband was humbled, he hadn't believed in God or heaven much at all. Since that time, there have been more hurtful and painful experiences in my life, and I wonder why I was not allowed to die on May 28th, twenty-three years ago, only to be left here living a life of emotional hell. But I understand; I have a greater purpose, and that is to live the best life I can, no matter what happens on Earth. I watch life around me and wonder about how pathetic people are, and how their lives would/could be so much better if they would just let go of their egos and let the love of our God lead their hearts and heal their pain.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She states she has “a greater purpose,” described as: “to live the best life I can, no matter what happens on Earth.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency cesarean section with inability to breathe; describes “drowning in the fluids of my own body and from the childbirth.”

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative emphasizes a bright light and being drawn toward it but “held back… like it was not my time,” with reluctance to return; no OBE, tunnel, life review, or detailed realm described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard a nurse say: “Show her baby to her; it could be for the last time.” Reports being “held back” from the light as if it was “not my time.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I saw a bright white light - beautiful, peaceful - and I was being drawn into the light, but I was being held back for some reason, like it was not my time.” / “I didn't want to 'come back' to life. Where I was it was so peaceful and I wanted to stay there, I was not afraid.” / “But I understand; I have a greater purpose, and that is to live the best life I can, no matter what happens on Earth.”
